rationale: Extend the existing governed intelligence-response execution runtime with a production adapter for the already-governed EVIDENCE_RESOLUTION_ENFORCED stage. The adapter requires explicit USER_ANSWER evidence use and delegates only to the existing publication-backed Evidence Resolver. No new orchestration authority, stage, reasoning behavior, insurance fact, or recommendation capability is introduced.
supersession_impact: No orchestration capability is superseded. The canonical stage order and generic orchestration service remain unchanged. This adapter becomes an owned implementation of II.ORCHESTRATION.EXECUTION_RUNTIME for ordinary user-answer evidence-stage composition, while historical pilot/certification adapters remain bounded by their existing scope.
authority_impact: No authority is expanded. The adapter cannot publish knowledge, alter evidence semantics, or bypass evidence admission. It requires explicit USER_ANSWER use and delegates evidence authority to the existing publication-backed Evidence Resolver; unpublished or internally certified evidence fails closed at the canonical evidence stage.
